metadata.coverage_note: Evergreen markers are facilities with at least one parsed report above 35 red points. metadata.data_universe: Scraper-observed TPCHD Accela food-facility inspection records with parsed PDF reports; this public evergreen layer includes facilities with at least one record over the red-point threshold.
metadata.freshness_note: Generated from the latest TPCHD scraper/publication run.

metadata.map_claim: Shows geocoded public restaurant facilities with at least one parsed inspection above 35 red points, with current TPCHD status and later observed inspection context where available.

privacy.review: Exact restaurant locations are public commercial facility addresses from public inspection records.

symbology.note: Evergreen markers use current/actionable TPCHD status as the primary color/letter encoding. Historical red-point severity is shown in popups and filters. Alert/run maps use fixed red-point classes with darker red for higher totals.
